fixtures.description: One call per wrapper endpoint Ledgr uses, plus edge and error cases, in this order (name on each pair). The wrong-api-key and unknown-sync-id pairs were sent with a bad key / bad sync id.
Every request of one sync.syncAll (55): accounts, 9 balances, categories, months, 2 reads per category note, per-account transactions.
ActualClient.createTransaction twice with one payload: POST, read-back, POST, read-back. Both POSTs answer {"message":"ok"}; the second read-back holds two rows with the same imported_id.
budget.syncBudgetToApi with one link to a category id that does not exist: GET note returns "", PUT returns 200, then the cache refresh.
pushSnapshotToBudgetApi create: scan two accounts, balance, POST adjustment, read-back.
resyncPortfolioPush: scan, DELETE old adjustment, balance, POST, read-back, per account.
Snapshot dated 2026-12-15 (after the wrapper's today): the POST lands, the read-back without until_date omits it, so Ledgr reports failure with nothing rolled back.
A request the wrapper rejects with 500 ("Unknown error"), sent through ActualClient.request: 6 identical PUTs.
PATCH /transactions/:id with date "06/10/2026": 200 "Transaction updated"; the stored date did not change.
12 concurrent requests to a freshly started wrapper (through the proxy): 8 failed with 500, then the same 12 again all 200. Order is completion order.
